description: Land  Title  Settlement  Department   -  Etawarahena, Dambulla D/S Division,  Matale  District  - Cad. Map No.  310018 and others
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, locations, and ownership details) by the Commissioner of Title Settlement. The content focuses on land ownership, title settlement, and property registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it primarily concerns land and property-related administrative matters.
